analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host macro validation HR@10 of 0.485: +0.0037 versus the reported previous 0.4813, but −0.020 versus baseline 0.505. Category HR@10 was 0.525 Movies_and_TV, 0.530 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.385 Electronics, and 0.500 CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics remained weakest. Padding-aware attention produced a modest observed gain, but this single comparison does not establish causality or consistent improvement. No held-out test results were available.
code_summary: One independent SASRec model per category: 96-dimensional embeddings, two pre-normalized Transformer blocks, two attention heads, GELU feed-forward layers, dropout 0.3, learned positional embeddings and item bias. Boolean SDPA masking excludes padding and future keys for valid queries; padding queries attend only to themselves before outputs are zeroed. A deterministic check covers left-padded, unpadded and entirely padded inputs. Training retains sampled softmax with 2,048 negatives, a 2,048-token cap, balanced positional sampling and endpoint weighting, AdamW, seed 42 and environment-controlled 200 epochs. Validation HR@10 selects one checkpoint per category with NDCG tie-breaking. The generated predictor dynamically imports this trial’s architecture and routes each category to its single checkpoint; no ensemble or separately fitted scores are used.
